name: numi-lab
description: Guide Codex through native research workflows across the Apple Silicon Numi Lab suite.

interface.longDescription: Use Codex to discover, operate, and improve Apple-native research workflows across NumiVivo, NumiTissue, NumiBrain and NumanX, Numi Human, Matter and NumiSolver, robotics, BirdFlow, and Numi Automata. Codex routes the task to its owning tool, checks live capabilities and existing artifacts, and reports measured outcomes with their evidence limits. The plugin supplies instructions; each runtime must be installed separately and accessible in the selected local environment. Research follows a standard instrument, prediction, controlled experiment, evidence, and model-revision loop, including a fresh test of revised predictions.
capabilities: Discover installed Numi tools and workflows
Build instruments, test predictions, and revise models from evidence
Inspect embodied brain and Human mechanics
Evaluate robot policies and retained evidence
defaultPrompt: Check this Mac’s Numi Lab setup and show which native workflows are ready.
Use my prepared NumiVivo system for an MD run and inspect its evidence.
Test a Numi hypothesis with controlled experiments and revise the model from the evidence.
